snippet.title: ShantyTown - Official Trailer | Mundo Gamer Showcase 2026 - Edition 01
snippet.description:
What if chaos could become something beautiful?

ShantyTown is a relaxing diorama-building game about finding harmony in dense and chaotic urban spaces.

Stack buildings, fill every corner, and create a cozy city that feels alive and uniquely yours.

🛒 Add it to your Steam wishlist
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2434600/ShantyTown/

🏙️ About the Game

🏗️ Build Without Limits
• Create dense urban spaces filled with personality
• Stack structures and use every inch creatively

🎨 Express Your Creativity
• Place decorations, lights, and details freely
• No wrong answers, every creation is valid

📸 Capture Your Work
• Frame your scenes and take photos
• Build a personal collection of your creations

🌆 Unique Locations
• Explore 20 handcrafted environments
• Each location has its own identity and atmosphere

💡 Smart Building Systems
• Upgrade buildings with lighting and utilities
• Unlock new objects and customization options

🌿 A Relaxing Experience
• No time limits or pressure
• Designed for calm and creativity
